description_en: Supports health codes from major provinces and cities across China, and outputs classification results for key fields in health code images, such as name, date, time, color, and remarks
description_zh: 包括全国主要省市健康码，支持健康码图片的姓名、日期、时间、颜色、备注信息等主要字段的识别结果输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-health-code --url 'https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i3/O1CN01ME0L7j29f6VRZKo5e_!!6000000008094-0-tps-1237-1981.jpg' --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeHealthCode
